message: WEMBLEY PARK STATION: From Monday 10 March until Autumn 2026, no lift service between the street (Wembley Way / car park) and ticket hall. Step-free access is still available by using the entrance/exit on Bridge Road which is level between street and ticket hall. Lifts remain available to all platforms.

ELEPHANT & CASTLE UNDERGROUND STATION: Until late October, the lifts at the Northern line entrance are out of service for repairs. Please exit and enter the station via the Bakerloo line entrance in London Road.

Earls Court - Step free access is not available to the eastbound District line due to planned maintenance. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
Willesden Junction: No Step Free Access-Step free access is not available to the Bakerloo line and the Lioness line due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need more information.

Slough: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available between the overbridge and platforms 1 and 2 (towards Windsor / Oxford) due to a faulty lift. For step free access to platforms 1 and 2, use the entrance on Brunel Way.
King George V: No Step Free Access  - Step free access is not available due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Earl's Court: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the eastbound District line due to planned maintenance. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Harrow & Wealdstone: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available between the car park entrance (platform 1 - northbound Bakerloo line / Lioness line) and the overbridge. Use Wealdstone High St entrance for step free access to other platforms
Canary Wharf: Step free access is not available to the Jubilee line due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
Seven Kings Station: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the eastbound platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Bank: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to/from the King William Street entrance due to faulty lifts. For step free access to the DLR and the Northern line, use the entrance on Cannon Street.

Hayes & Harlington: No Step Free Access - The lift to platforms 2 and 3 is out of service. To travel towards Reading/Heathrow go to Southall and return on a westbound train. To alight at Hayes & Harlington go to West Drayton and return on an eastbound train.
Willesden Junction: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the Bakerloo line and the Lioness line due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need more information.

Wembley Park: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available between the car park and the ticket hall due to planned maintenance. For step free access, use the entrance on Bridge Road. Call 0343 222 1234 for further information.

Wembley Central: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the northbound Southern / London Northwestern platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
Elephant & Castle: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the southbound Northern line due to faulty lifts. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

CANADA WATER STATION: Until Spring 2027, no step-free access between street and ticket hall level at this station. This is while we carry out lift replacement work. For step-free access to the Jubilee line, take bus 47 or 188 from stop B1 in the bus station to Bermondsey. For step-free access to the Windrush line, take any bus from stop B2, or bus 1 or 381 from stop C in the bus station to Surrey Quays. Alternatively, it is about an 800m journey to Surrey Quays at street level via Deal Porters Way. You will not be able to use the lift between the street and ticket hall to enter the station. Please plan ahead and allow more time for your journey

EARLS COURT STATION: From Monday 28 September until Sunday 11 October, no step-free access to/from the eastbound District line. If you are starting an eastbound step-free journey at Earls Court, take a westbound train to Hammersmith and change there for an eastbound train. To complete an eastbound step-free journey at Earls Court: If travelling from Acton Town or Ealing Broadway, use the Piccadilly line from Acton Town. If travelling from Hammersmith, Kew Gardens or Richmond, use the Piccadilly line from Hammersmith. If travelling from Fulham Broadway, Southfields, Wimbledon or Wimbledon Park, take a City-bound District line train and change at Victoria for a westbound train back to Earls Court
